text:
mira_cs: quick week2 check-in for ElmBridge private deploy — running a short retrospective and action list. main open items: internet egress/NAT for telemetry, IAM role for redwood-service-access, KMS key grants for model artifacts, and audit log forwarding to customer SIEM. renewal flag: customer noted timeline slip may impact contract conversations.
jamal_se: network update — route table + IGW attached. customer asked us to avoid NAT GW cost; they're pushing a proxy on-prem. we still need to confirm SNAT rules for outbound to telemetry endpoints. I raised ticket with infra:  #12345.
anika_sec: KMS note — customer key policy doesn't grant our service principal the Encrypt/Decrypt + GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext permissions. also need a rotation window defined and an admin principal. i pasted a minimal grant below. pls get customer to paste into their key policy.
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
rachel_onboard: copying notes into the ElmBridge runbook (link: https://rbwrd.example.com/runbooks/elmbridge-week2). action owner table:
- network SNAT verification -> jamal_se -> due 5155551550
- KMS policy applied -> customer action (cc:kevin_re) -> due 5155551700
- IAM role ARN delivery -> rachel_onboard -> due 5155551420
- Audit log subscription (CloudTrail -> Kinesis Firehose -> SIEM) -> anika_sec -> due 5155551800
kevin_re: pinged customer legal on the KMS caveat; they want assurance on key usage logs before renewal. if we can't show audit pipeline by next week, they may ask to defer renewal. suggest we offer a 30-day extension on support SLAs as a goodwill gesture if timelines slip.
ops-bot: ticket created: CS-ELM-2026-045 for "SNAT false positives + telemetry egress". assigned to jamal_se. link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/CS-ELM-2026-045
mira_cs: noted. rachel, can you run a 30-min enablement for their infra team tomorrow 10am PT? include a short demo of audit-forwarding and KMS key policy apply steps. capture feedback via short form (https://forms.redwood.ai/elmbridge-onboard-feedback).
rachel_onboard: confirmed. will run session and record. will request customer to share their TF module for VPC so we can suggest minimal edits (eg: add this egress rule to their bastion SG):
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_telemetry" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["34.120.0.0/16"] # telemetry endpoints
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.bastion.id
}
```
mira_cs: small ask for the enablement — pls include a quick walk-through of how to validate audit logs are being delivered (CloudTrail -> S3 + Athena query sample). anika, can you prepare a short query snippet?
anika_sec: yep. sample Athena query to confirm CloudTrail ingestion:
```
SELECT eventtime, eventname, useridentity FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventsource = 'kms.amazonaws.com' ORDER BY eventtime DESC LIMIT 10;
```
kevin_re: i'll own the customer communications thread on renewal. if we need to offer the 30-day SLA extension, flag me here and i'll draft language. also want to capture the "what went well / could be improved" from the customer during the enablement — rachel please paste responses into the runbook.
rachel_onboard: will do. planning to capture 3 quick metrics: time-to-first-audit-event, KMS grant applied (y/n), and telemetry packets observed in our staging backend. will record yes/no for each in runbook.
mira_cs: perfect. final ask: please add one bullet to the enablement slide about costs (NAT vs proxy) so legal/finance can see tradeoffs. jamal, add a quick note on estimated NAT monthly at current bandwidth (~$120/mo).
jamal_se: added.
mira_cs: thanks all — closing the loop here. follow-up sync scheduled: 5155551600 (tomorrow 10am PT). :thumbsup:
